Actual Article Body:
Canada’s military disclosed on Thursday that a live grenade exercise was the cause of a recent deadly fire at an Alberta base, where four Canadian service members were killed and 39 people were injured.

The grenade training sparked the fast-moving grass fire that was picked up by strong winds at the Canadian military base on Saturday, catching the soldiers off guard.
